command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

# Diagnostics written BEFORE racon runs: it SIGILLs on Apple Silicon (no SVE), and whether
# that is a build problem or a host-feature problem can only be answered on real hardware.
{ printf 'racon_version\t%s\n' "$(racon --version 2>&1 | head -1)"
  printf 'uname\t%s\n' "$(uname -m)"
  printf 'cpu_features\t%s\n' "$(grep -m1 Features /proc/cpuinfo 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f2- | tr -s ' ')"
} > polish-diag.txt
cat polish-diag.txt
cleanup(){ cp -f racon.log polish-racon.log 2>/dev/null || :; }
trap cleanup EXIT

echo "== polish =="
racon -t 2 reads.fq ov.paf draft.fa > polished.fa 2> racon.log || { echo "racon FAILED:"; tail -15 racon.log; exit 1; }
test -s polished.fa || { echo "racon produced no output"; exit 1; }

awk '!/^>/{printf "%s", $0} END{print ""}' truth.fa    > t.seq
awk '!/^>/{printf "%s", $0} END{print ""}' draft.fa    > d.seq
awk '!/^>/{printf "%s", $0} END{print ""}' polished.fa > p.seq
TL=$(awk '{print length($0)}' t.seq); DL=$(awk '{print length($0)}' d.seq); PL=$(awk '{print length($0)}' p.seq)

EXACT=no; cmp -s t.seq p.seq && EXACT=yes
# residual differences where lengths allow a positional comparison
MM=$(awk 'NR==FNR{a=$0; next} { b=$0; n=0; L=(length(a)<length(b)?length(a):length(b))
  for(i=1;i<=L;i++) if (substr(a,i,1)!=substr(b,i,1)) n++; print n }' t.seq p.seq)
DMM=$(awk 'NR==FNR{a=$0; next} { b=$0; n=0; L=(length(a)<length(b)?length(a):length(b))
  for(i=1;i<=L;i++) if (substr(a,i,1)!=substr(b,i,1)) n++; print n }' t.seq d.seq)

PSUB=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="planted_substitutions"{print $2}' truth.tsv)
PDEL=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="planted_deletions"{print $2}'     truth.tsv)

# The claim: polishing must move the draft TOWARD the truth. Exact recovery is asserted if
# achieved; otherwise the directional claim is the honest one and is asserted instead.
test "$PL" = "$TL" || { echo "polished length $PL != truth $TL"; exit 1; }
test "$EXACT" = yes || { echo "polished is not byte-identical to the truth ($MM positional mismatches)"; exit 1; }

{
printf 'racon -- a draft with planted errors, polished back against reads from the truth\n'
printf 'racon_version\t%s\n' "$(racon --version 2>&1 | head -1)"
printf 'planted_errors\t%s substitutions + %s deletions\n' "$PSUB" "$PDEL"
printf 'lengths\ttruth %s / draft %s / polished %s   (assert polished == truth)\n' "$TL" "$DL" "$PL"
printf 'draft_vs_truth\t%s positional mismatches before polishing\n' "$DMM"
printf 'polished_vs_truth\t%s positional mismatches   (assert 0)\n' "$MM"
printf 'byte_identical\t%s   (assert yes -- EXACT: the polished consensus IS the true sequence)\n' "$EXACT"
printf 'note\tthe reads carry no errors, so the truth is fully recoverable and exact equality is\n'
printf 'note\tthe right assertion. On real noisy reads the honest claim is DIRECTIONAL -- fewer\n'
printf 'note\tdifferences after polishing than before -- because a consensus cannot beat its evidence.\n'
} | tee smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
